title: Prospective case manifest (manifest.json)
description: Versioned, engine-visible descriptor of one prospective case directory, written by `miner prospective-export` as prospective/manifest.json alongside metadata.json and change.patch. Matches internal/prospectiveexport.Manifest and internal/prospectiveexport.ValidateManifest exactly. This is the only file in the prospective directory permitted to carry head_sha/comparison_base_sha; metadata.json's six-field reviewer allowlist deliberately omits them. See docs/export-contract.md §9-§10.

schema_version.description: Fixed contract version identifier; consumers must reject any other value.

case_id.description: Opaque identifier generated by the miner (GenerateCaseID) from a SHA-256 of repository, PR number, and cutoff. Never a caller-supplied, PR-derived string like "case-15624".

repository.description: owner/repo, copied from the selected correlated record's original.repository and cross-checked against the cache bundle's repository identity.

cutoff_timestamp.description: RFC3339Nano UTC benchmark-view cutoff; must match metadata.json's cutoff_timestamp.

comparison_base_sha.description: Git merge-base of original.base_sha and original.head_sha, resolved locally via `git merge-base` (not merely copied from the cached provider response).

head_sha.description: PR head SHA, cross-checked against the cache bundle's head SHA before publication.

artifacts.description: SHA-256 of every other file published in the same prospective directory; a consumer must recompute and verify each before trusting the directory.
